title: The Feast of the Borrowed Colors
description: At the first feast after a gray winter, a glassworker brings a tray of colored tiles into the square. People on the steps hold out their hands to catch the light.
alt: An artisan holds a tray of cut glass that casts vivid red, blue, and green shapes over a pale stone square and the people on its steps.
pairing: First sunshine feast × colored glass that paints a gray town with light
